paths.description: Homepage and global navigation, representing the primary portal entry and global shell.
Rental category landing page, representing listing/search entry templates.
New condominium search, representing search controls and purchase categories.
Kanto regional landing, representing geographic category templates.
SUUMO to Recruit ID login, representing account/authentication and invalid-form recovery.
Separate /sp/ mobile presentation, inspected because desktop pages advertise it as their mobile alternate.
Unknown route, representing HTTP/navigation failure recovery.

findings.summary: Emulated dark mode left body white (rgb(255,255,255)), text rgb(51,51,51), and color-scheme computed as normal.
findings.evidence: Emulated dark mode left body white (rgb(255,255,255)), text rgb(51,51,51), and color-scheme computed as normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and theme semantic surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Lighthouse failed color-contrast, and the prefers-contrast capture showed no preference-specific retinting.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed color-contrast, and the prefers-contrast capture showed no preference-specific retinting.
findings.suggestedFix: Meet WCAG contrast ratios and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast adjustments for essential controls.

findings.summary: CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations; representative navigation swaps are abrupt full-document loads.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin template navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The 3,796px homepage uses static chrome and exposed no scroll-state query or progress/scroll affordance.
findings.evidence: The 3,796px homepage uses static chrome and exposed no scroll-state query or progress/scroll affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive sticky chrome or a lightweight scroll-state/progress affordance where it helps orientation.

findings.summary: Primary product selectors use javascript:void(0) controls and abrupt content swaps without a visible focus/attention cue.
findings.evidence: Primary product selectors use javascript:void(0) controls and abrupt content swaps without a visible focus/attention cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real links or buttons, move visible focus to revealed content, and add directional transitions where useful.

findings.summary: The homepage has zero dialog, popover, or details elements while multiple menu controls are javascript:void(0), indicating ad-hoc disclosure controls.
findings.evidence: The homepage has zero dialog, popover, or details elements while multiple menu controls are javascript:void(0), indicating ad-hoc disclosure controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons plus details/popover/dialog according to modality, with declarative dismissal and focus behavior.

findings.summary: The first viewport is densely divided into bordered panels, product selectors, ads, promos, and tiny secondary links, competing with the core search task.
findings.evidence: The first viewport is densely divided into bordered panels, product selectors, ads, promos, and tiny secondary links, competing with the core search task.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce panel borders and promotional modules above the fold; establish one dominant search path.

findings.summary: The root and major templates omit viewport meta.
findings.evidence: The root and major templates omit viewport meta. At a 360x800 emulation Chrome used a 980px layout viewport and scaled the fixed 950px page down, making text and targets tiny.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve one responsive URL with width=device-width, fluid/intrinsic layout, and no fixed 950px desktop canvas.

findings.summary: CSS inspection found no @container usage and the same fixed-width card/map composition is merely scaled on narrow screens.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container usage and the same fixed-width card/map composition is merely scaled on narrow screens.
findings.suggestedFix: Make reusable search/cards container-aware and allow them to recompose at narrow inline sizes.

findings.summary: Focused controls on home, listing, and search templates computed outline: none with no box shadow.
findings.evidence: Focused controls on home, listing, and search templates computed outline: none with no box shadow; many scaled targets are visually tiny.
findings.suggestedFix: Add robust :focus-visible styles and maintain at least 24x24 CSS px targets, preferably 44x44 for primary touch actions.

findings.summary: Lighthouse performance was 0.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse performance was 0.53 with LCP 4.6s and TBT 1,150ms; trace corroborated LCP 3.61s in a separate run.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, reduce third-party startup, and break/defer non-critical work.

findings.summary: Lighthouse measured 1,150ms TBT and 400ms max potential FID.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 1,150ms TBT and 400ms max potential FID; trace recorded a 136ms long task.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer analytics/experimentation, split long tasks, and load secondary code after interaction or idle.

findings.summary: HAR recorded 276 requests and 4.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 276 requests and 4.41MB transferred; confirmed parser-inserted classic scripts lacked async/defer, including jQuery 1.4.2 and site bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten critical chains, defer classic scripts, preload only the LCP asset, and apply useful caching.

findings.summary: HAR recorded 61 scripts and 3.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 61 scripts and 3.09MB script transfer; repeated Yahoo conversion scripts and many advertising tags dominate startup.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory and deduplicate tags, gate non-essential vendors, and conditionally load code after consent or use.

findings.summary: Image audit found 37 of 60 images without alt.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 37 of 60 images without alt; listing probes found 22-24 missing alt images and unlabeled visible search controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide meaningful alt or alt="" for decoration, and associate every input/select with a visible label or accessible name.

findings.summary: Lighthouse color-contrast audit failed on the homepage.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast audit failed on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust text and control color tokens to meet WCAG AA in all states.

findings.summary: Lighthouse found non-sequential headings and no main landmark.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found non-sequential headings and no main landmark; representative controls had no visible focus outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/landmarks, repair heading order, and implement visible focus throughout the keyboard path.

findings.summary: At 360px the fixed desktop canvas is scaled to roughly 36.
findings.evidence: At 360px the fixed desktop canvas is scaled to roughly 36.7%, producing very small labels and dense multi-column copy.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive type/layout without whole-page scaling and preserve readable line lengths and minimum text size.

findings.summary: Desktop templates lack viewport meta.
findings.evidence: Desktop templates lack viewport meta; the separate mobile page sets user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1, explicitly preventing zoom.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user zoom, remove maximum-scale/user-scalable restrictions, and ensure 320 CSS px reflow.

findings.summary: Lighthouse reported browser errors in the console.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported browser errors in the console.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix runtime/network exceptions and keep production console error-free.

findings.summary: Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but image inspection found 3 images served at 10x displayed width, 24 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, and 36 legacy-format images.
findings.evidence: Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but image inspection found 3 images served at 10x displayed width, 24 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, and 36 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep valid metadata while adding responsive image sources, modern formats, lazy loading, and right-sized variants.

findings.summary: Lighthouse reported a deprecated API warning, DevTools inspector issues, a BFCache failure, and third-party-cookie problems.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported a deprecated API warning, DevTools inspector issues, a BFCache failure, and third-party-cookie problems; the page ships jQuery 1.4.2.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated APIs and BFCache blockers, address inspector issues, and retire stale dependencies.

findings.summary: Lighthouse failed crawlable anchors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable anchors; the homepage has javascript:void(0) navigation and no viewport meta.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href links for navigation and add a correct responsive viewport declaration.

findings.summary: Public templates returned 200 and robots permits them, but homepage/category probes found no canonical.
findings.evidence: Public templates returned 200 and robots permits them, but homepage/category probes found no canonical; meta robots also applies noarchive.
findings.suggestedFix: Add self-consistent canonical URLs and review whether noarchive is intentional; align sitemap/robots signals.

findings.summary: Homepage probe found no Open Graph tags and no JSON-LD despite representing a major organization and search service.
findings.evidence: Homepage probe found no Open Graph tags and no JSON-LD despite representing a major organization and search service.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter preview metadata.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but the main-document header probe found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, referrer, or permissions policy.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but the main-document header probe found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, referrer, or permissions policy; 29 cookies were flagged insecure and JSESSIONID was not HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP in report-only then enforce it; add HSTS/nosniff and secure, HttpOnly, appropriately SameSite cookies.

findings.summary: Tracker probe found 34 third-party origins.
findings.evidence: Tracker probe found 34 third-party origins; HAR counted 216 third-party requests and 3.06MB, including Google, Meta, TikTok, Twitter, Yahoo, Spotify, VWO, and ad vendors.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit vendor necessity, obtain meaningful consent, minimise event collection, and delay/batch non-essential analytics.

findings.summary: Header probe found no clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP/Trusted Types signal, or nosniff.
findings.evidence: Header probe found no clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP/Trusted Types signal, or nosniff.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options), Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, nosniff, and strengthen XSS defenses.

findings.summary: Ad-hoc javascript:void(0) controls and fixed desktop geometry make navigation/state behavior dependent on legacy scripts and fragile at narrow sizes.
findings.evidence: Ad-hoc javascript:void(0) controls and fixed desktop geometry make navigation/state behavior dependent on legacy scripts and fragile at narrow sizes.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance real links/buttons and use native disclosure/overlay primitives with responsive geometry.

findings.summary: Image audit found 3 images at 10x display width, 36 legacy-format images, 16 without srcset, and 24 below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 3 images at 10x display width, 36 legacy-format images, 16 without srcset, and 24 below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive variants, use srcset/sizes, and lazy-load below-fold imagery.

findings.summary: The homepage issued 276 requests, including 105 fetch/XHR calls and 61 scripts, for a mostly static portal entry page.
findings.evidence: The homepage issued 276 requests, including 105 fetch/XHR calls and 61 scripts, for a mostly static portal entry page.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate redundant beacons and defer or batch background fetches until consent/interaction.

findings.summary: Third parties account for 216 requests and 3.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 216 requests and 3.06MB of 4.41MB transferred, with Google Tag Manager alone at 2.09MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget and remove or conditionally load vendors that do not serve the current task.

findings.summary: A mostly static homepage retained 44.
findings.evidence: A mostly static homepage retained 44.0MB self-size across 785,906 heap nodes before interaction, a disproportionate footprint consistent with its heavy vendor stack.
